truth_boundary: The ranking is a deterministic research priority, not provider admission. Public product documentation can establish product reality or lack of access but cannot create KIDULTS rights. Discogs standard Restricted Data terms, Cardmarket aggregate price guides and closed new API intake, and eBay restricted Marketplace Insights access do not yield a rights-clear transaction-level Current-SOLD feed. A source-specific written agreement, complete provider specification, deterministic PASS, explicit approvals, and a separate acquisition gate are all required before contact, account or terms acceptance, credentials, network calls, spend, data acquisition, adapter work, Candidate/Evidence, Track B, Public, Production, or G5 promotion.
